## Interactive navigation fixes

PriceRadar 1.7.5 finishes the interactive navigation work from the latest unreleased branch.

### What changed

- Full-screen swiping between Watchlist, Coupons and Settings follows your finger.
- Dragging the bottom navigation pill moves the page directly.
- Fixed the pager structure so adjacent screens render correctly during a gesture.
- Fixed the incorrect grey overlay and kept one clear animated selection pill.
- Tap navigation and reduced-motion behavior remain available.

Download **PriceRadar-1.7.5.apk** below.

The APK checksum is included in **SHA256SUMS.txt**.
